title: PaymentValidated v1
description: Published by Reservations when a payment or transfer support is accepted. Consumers per the domain event catalog: Cash, Reports, Audit. Proposed contract: no publisher exists yet.

paymentStatus.description: Payment status of the reservation after the validation.

validator.description: Reference of the person who validated the payment.

paymentAttemptRef.description: Reference of the payment attempt being validated. NOT in the catalog's minimum data for this event: added so Cash can enforce a business-level unique key against republished facts (open point of Session 1). Since nothing is published yet, including it in v1 is not a breaking change.
